kind: Pinned original Abseil, contained Windows SDK, and Zig dependency selection source proof

sdk.include_precedence: The one-file contained SDK directory provides TraceLoggingProvider.h only. Its evntprov.h resolves to the pinned Zig MinGW family. The original V8 provider includes windows.h before the SDK header. No SDK shared/um/ucrt directory is added.
sdk.selected_API_path: Recipe sets original _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00. sdkddkver.h supplies WINVER from that macro; MinGW evntprov.h declares EventRegister/EventUnregister/EventWriteTransfer/EventSetInformation and defines EVENT_FILTER_TYPE_SCHEMATIZED. Original SDK therefore chooses TLG_HAVE_EVENT_SET_INFORMATION=1 under these declarations, with the direct EventSetInformation path.
sdk.original_descriptor_compatibility: Selected SDK body uses EVENT_DATA_DESCRIPTOR Ptr/Size/Reserved fields and (EVENT_INFO_CLASS)2 rather than requiring a named EventProviderSetTraits enumerator. These fields and EVENT_INFO_CLASS exist in the pinned MinGW header.
sdk.MS_extensions: Recorder sources request -fms-extensions for original SDK __pragma/__declspec. The original __annotation, __fastfail and metadata section emission are retained and still require future actual Zig Clang/MinGW compile/link validation.

waiter_matrix.reason: Win32 waiter excludes MinGW, pthread waiter excludes Windows/MinGW, futex/semaphore availability is absent on this selection; unchanged priority order reaches StdcppWaiter. ThreadIdentity Windows CPP11 branch also excludes MinGW.

waiter_matrix.selection: Windows native non-MinGW predicate branch (retained original, not qualified here)

waiter_matrix.assembly_limit: Main network and native-memory owners still only admit Windows/Linux; this source selection is not whole-Agent Darwin admission.

minGW_pthread_link_owner.recipe: build_native_node_abseil.zig requests pthread only for target.result.isMinGW().
minGW_pthread_link_owner.Zig_resolution: lib/std/Build/Module.zig calls isLibCLibName; lib/std/zig/target.zig recognizes pthread and winpthread for MinGW, enabling the existing libc owner instead of creating another archive.

stacktrace_macro_selection.NO_FRAME_POINTER: Not defined by recipe. Original explicit NO_FRAME_POINTER x86/x64/aarch64 libunwind include is not available to open-source users and is not claimed by this finite closure.

method: Read-only exact hashes and original predicate/declaration inspection. Deductions above are conditional on the recorded target macro family; no preprocessor/compiler was executed.
limits: The transitive selection records the concrete SDK/MinGW declaration boundary, not a compiler-selected complete Windows header graph.
Compiler built-ins, C++ ABI, Microsoft extension handling, ETW metadata sections, import linkage and runtime provider behavior remain unqualified.
No forced waiter/thread identity, no replacement std mutex, no patched SDK original, no synthesized provider or no-op event path is added.
The entire original Abseil mutex/condition implementation remains present; Node tracing conditions separately retain their original uv_cond_* owner.
